children: Maersk third-quarter earnings landed below expectations while new guidance implies that earnings in the fourth quarter will be slightly lower than in the third, Sydbank senior analyst Mikkel Emil Jensen writes. "Our assessment is therefore that the quarter in isolation is slightly weaker than expected." Group Ebitda of $4.7 billion is around 8% below consensus while EBIT and net profit also disappointed, mainly due to the ocean business, where volume trends were slightly weaker than anticipated and costs came in higher than expected, Sydbank says. Shares in the Danish shipping group fall 8.9%. (dominic.chopping@wsj.com)
